info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Brand Insights API
info.description: The Brand Insights API provides comprehensive access to key branding metrics and performance data. By using this endpoint, businesses can track brand awareness, engagement, and market positioning based on specific parameters. Typical consumers include marketing analysts and brand managers who utilize this data to inform strategic decisions and optimize marketing campaigns. The API enables companies to leverage insights for enhancing their brand presence in the marketplace.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific brand management resource identified by the given resource ID. Utilize this operation to access information about the brand's performance, strategy, and relevant metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the brand management details for the specified resource. It must adhere to the defined schema and may include various parameters to filter or sort the results based on specific criteria.
